company_profile.description: A profile for businesses that want to test a temporary kitchen workflow, menu, event model, or service area before making a larger commitment.
company_profile.primary_cta: Test your kitchen concept with a temporary setup
cta_variations: Test your kitchen concept with a temporary setup

service_profile.service_description: Mobile kitchen trailer rental for short-term kitchen trial. A profile for businesses that want to test a temporary kitchen workflow, menu, event model, or service area before making a larger commitment.

cooking: For short-term kitchen trial, each kitchen includes a stove, oven, and essential cooking utensils to support menu trial and new service area test. Additional equipment options are available through 24/7 support.
refrigeration: For short-term kitchen trial, a separate temporary mobile refrigerator trailer can support menu trial and new service area test. Pricing is 20 ft $2,453, 25 ft $2,953, 30 ft $3,453, 35 ft $3,953, and 40 ft $4,453. These are site-wide starting estimates after the site adjustment; city ETA discounts do not apply to refrigerator trailer pricing. Capacity, configuration, and availability are handled through 24/7 support.
preparation: To support menu trial and new service area test, preparation areas and requested equipment are reviewed before delivery for sanitation, functionality, site fit, and readiness. Additional equipment may be rented as needed for a site serving restaurants and food entrepreneurs, including access items such as stairs and ramps. The same preparation, equipment, and sanitation checks are repeated during off-rent maintenance.
sanitation: For short-term kitchen trial, every kitchen facility follows a sanitation plan before delivery, after the rental, and while the trailer is off rent for maintenance. The plan covers food-contact areas, sanitation-related connections, condition records, and readiness for the next dispatch.
storage: Storage needs for menu trial and new service area test can be reviewed with the selected kitchen configuration. Dry or cold storage options are available based on site requirements and the approved equipment package.
utilities: For short-term kitchen trial, the site is reviewed before delivery for approved power capacity and connection type, potable water supply, wastewater or gray-water drainage, fuel or gas requirements where applicable, ventilation clearances, trailer placement, access, stairs or ramps, and any required permits or inspections. Requirements depend on the trailer configuration and site conditions and are verified with the company before dispatch.

preparation_plan.purpose: Prepare each mobile kitchen facility and requested supporting equipment for restaurants and food entrepreneurs managing menu trial and new service area test, then keep it deployment-ready between rentals.
before_delivery: Clean and sanitize preparation surfaces and related food-contact areas.
Check preparation equipment and connected systems for functionality before dispatch.

Review the restaurants and food entrepreneurs request and site conditions to prepare the approved configuration for menu trial and new service area test, along with any requested additional equipment.
Review whether access equipment such as stairs, ramps, or other site-support items is needed and available for rental.
during_off_rent_maintenance: Recheck preparation equipment and related components for functionality while the trailer is off rent between short-term kitchen trial assignments.
Repeat sanitation and condition checks for preparation areas and supporting equipment used for menu trial and new service area test.
Document service needs, complete approved maintenance, and verify the configuration is ready for the next short-term kitchen trial assignment.
preparation_plan.additional_equipment_note: Additional equipment for short-term kitchen trial is subject to request, site requirements, availability, and company approval. Examples may include stairs, ramps, and other access or site-support equipment.

utilities_plan.power: For short-term kitchen trial, verify the approved power source, capacity, connection type, and connection location for the selected trailer configuration.
utilities_plan.water_supply: For menu trial and new service area test, verify a potable water source, required pressure or flow, hose connection, and availability at the placement area.
utilities_plan.wastewater: For a short-term kitchen trial deployment, verify the gray-water drainage, holding-tank, pump, or disposal method required for the selected configuration and site.
utilities_plan.fuel: For the equipment package selected for restaurants and food entrepreneurs and menu trial and new service area test, verify propane, natural gas, or other approved fuel requirements where applicable.
utilities_plan.ventilation: Before supporting menu trial and new service area test, verify ventilation, exhaust, clearance, and placement requirements for the trailer and selected equipment.
utilities_plan.site_access: For a short-term kitchen trial site, verify a suitable placement area, delivery access, clearances, level conditions, stairs, ramps, and other access needs.
utilities_plan.approvals: For short-term kitchen trial, verify permits, inspections, local code requirements, and utility coordination before delivery where applicable.
utilities_plan.pre_delivery_check: Before dispatch for menu trial and new service area test, verify that required connections, access, approvals, and site preparations are ready.
utilities_plan.confirmation_note: Exact utility specifications for short-term kitchen trial depend on the trailer configuration and site conditions and are verified with the company before dispatch.

sanitation_plan.purpose: Maintain a clean, safe, and deployment-ready kitchen facility throughout the rental lifecycle for short-term kitchen trial.
before_delivery: Clean and sanitize food-contact surfaces, cooking areas, preparation areas, dishwashing areas, and refrigeration interiors.
Check sanitation-related water, drainage, waste, and connection points before dispatch.
Document the trailer condition and verify that the facility is ready for menu trial and new service area test delivery and setup.
after_rental: After the short-term kitchen trial rental, remove food, waste, and customer-supplied materials from the facility.
Clean and sanitize cooking, preparation, dishwashing, storage, and refrigeration areas after return or pickup.
Inspect the facility, document cleaning and condition findings, and record any repair or service needs before the trailer is released.
off_rent_maintenance: Keep the trailer in a clean and sanitary condition while it is off rent between short-term kitchen trial assignments.
Complete scheduled inspection and maintenance of kitchen, dishwasher, refrigerator, water, drainage, and related operating components.
Resolve documented service items and verify sanitation readiness before the trailer is assigned to the next short-term kitchen trial rental.
sanitation_plan.confirmation_note: Final sanitation, inspection, and maintenance records for short-term kitchen trial should be verified through company operations before delivery and before the next rental assignment.

rental_options.extension_policy: Rental extensions may be requested before the scheduled return date and are subject to trailer availability, continued site suitability, and company approval. Any revised rental period, pricing, delivery or relocation costs, and return arrangements must be approved before the extension becomes effective.
rental_options.relocation_policy: Relocation requests must be submitted before the trailer is moved and are subject to company approval, route and access review, site suitability, utility disconnection and reconnection requirements, availability, and any applicable transport, setup, or relocation charges. The trailer must not be moved without prior company approval.

service_profile.commercial_focus: small-scope trials with clear success criteria and optional next steps

pricing.delivery_fee: Delivery fee is quote-based and depends on location, route, trailer size, site access, setup needs, and availability.
pricing.minimum_rental: Minimum rental pricing follows the selected kitchen size: 20 ft $5,953, 25 ft $6,453, 30 ft $6,953, 35 ft $7,453, and 40 ft $7,953. These are site-wide starting prices before any location-specific quote adjustments; the applicable rental term and final quote are provided with the company quote.

city_discount_policy.rule: Lowest numeric ETA receives the highest discount; discount decreases linearly with ETA and is rounded to one decimal percent.

temporary_refrigerator_trailer.pricing_basis: Site-wide refrigerator trailer pricing after the site adjustment; no city ETA discount applied.

delivery.availability_fallback: If the nearest approved inventory is unavailable, another approved service location may be used and the ETA may change.

faqs.question: Can I rent a trailer to test a food concept?
faqs.answer: A trial can be evaluated when the test objective, menu, site, utilities, access, and dates are defined.

faqs.question: What should a trial measure?
faqs.answer: Track production time, capacity, workflow, storage, sanitation, service volume, and what the permanent plan would require.

faqs.question: Can a trial become a longer rental?
faqs.answer: An extension or new term may be possible subject to availability and company approval.

faqs.question: How much equipment should I request for a test?
faqs.answer: Start with the smallest configuration that can answer the test question, then confirm the equipment fit with the company.

faqs.question: Can a pop-up pilot use the trailer?
faqs.answer: A pop-up pilot is a possible use case subject to venue approval, utilities, access, menu, and availability.

faqs.question: Is a trial automatically renewable?
faqs.answer: Do not assume automatic renewal; confirm term, notice, and extension rules.
